I am an old woman of 69 years, and this small plot near my house is just 0.06 hectares where I plant my cassava and cocoyam together. I cannot afford the chemical fertilizer from the agro-dealer, and even the subsidized one rarely reaches us here, so I just spread the household ash and some goat droppings I gather. I save my own cassava cuttings from last season like my mother taught me, and with my old age I work slowly on this plot myself, sometimes my granddaughter helps me when she is not in school.
